title: Concept: Railway project token in a response
description: A Railway backboard endpoint with a project token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A project token can deploy and read variables for the linked services, so it exposes every secret the deployment depends on, not just the one page that leaked it.
applicability: Deployments that render a Railway backboard endpoint with a project token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A project token can deploy and read variables for the linked services, so it exposes every secret the deployment depends on, not just the one page that leaked it.
